CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.billing_adult_seat()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ritc.member WHERE household_id=NEW.household_id AND member_id=NEW.member_id AND kind='adult' AND state='active') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'billing seats require active adults' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.consent_revoke_once()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.revoked_at IS NULL OR
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-'revoked_at') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'revoked_at') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'consent can only be revoked once; new evidence required' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 RETURNS boolean

 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ritc.identity_erasure WHERE identity_hash=encode(sha256(convert_to(identity_issuer||E'\n'||identity_subject,'utf8')),'hex'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.immutable_row()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF ritc.privacy_erasure_authorized() THEN RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END; END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.lock_household_access()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM ritc.household WHERE household_id=OLD.household_id FOR UPDATE;
  RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.maintenance_claim_logout(lease_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(token_hash text, secret_cipher text, subject text, session_id text, access_expires_at timestamp with time zone, attempt integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN QUERY WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT a.token_hash FROM ritc.browser_auth a WHERE a.secret_cipher IS NOT NULL AND (a.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR a.expires_at<=clock_timestamp())
    AND a.logout_state NOT IN ('complete','expired_unconfirmed') AND (a.logout_next_at IS NULL OR a.logout_next_at<=clock_timestamp())
    AND (a.logout_lease_until IS NULL OR a.logout_lease_until<clock_timestamp())
  ORDER BY a.logout_next_at NULLS FIRST,a.expires_at,a.token_hash FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
 ) UPDATE ritc.browser_auth a SET revoked_at=COALESCE(a.revoked_at,clock_timestamp()),email_cipher=NULL,logout_state='leased',logout_lease_id=lease_id,
 logout_lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',logout_attempts=a.logout_attempts+1
 FROM candidate c WHERE a.token_hash=c.token_hash
 RETURNING a.token_hash,a.secret_cipher,a.subject,a.session_id,a.access_expires_at,a.logout_attempts;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.maintenance_finish_logout(record_hash text, lease_id uuid, outcome text, error_code text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF outcome NOT IN ('complete','retry','expired_unconfirmed') OR (error_code IS NOT NULL AND error_code NOT IN ('provider_unavailable','configuration_unavailable','token_expired','cipher_unavailable')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid maintenance outcome'; END IF;
 IF outcome='retry' THEN
  UPDATE ritc.browser_auth a SET logout_state='pending',logout_next_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>least(3600,30*power(2,least(a.logout_attempts,7)))::integer),
   logout_lease_id=NULL,logout_lease_until=NULL,logout_last_error=error_code WHERE a.token_hash=record_hash AND a.logout_lease_id=lease_id AND a.logout_state='leased';
 ELSE
  UPDATE ritc.browser_auth a SET logout_state=outcome,logout_finished_at=clock_timestamp(),logout_last_error=error_code,logout_lease_id=NULL,logout_lease_until=NULL,
   phase='challenge',secret_cipher=NULL,email_cipher=NULL,issuer=NULL,subject=NULL,session_id=NULL,access_expires_at=NULL
  WHERE a.token_hash=record_hash AND a.logout_lease_id=lease_id AND a.logout_state='leased';
 END IF;
 RETURN FOUND;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.measurement_consent_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (NEW.household_id,NEW.consent_id,NEW.member_id,NEW.notice_version,NEW.granted_at) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (OLD.household_id,OLD.consent_id,OLD.member_id,OLD.notice_version,OLD.granted_at)
    OR (OLD.withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.withdrawn_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.withdrawn_at) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'measurement consent requires a fresh explicit action' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.measurement_feedback_eligible()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ritc.measurement_consent c JOIN ritc.member m USING(household_id,member_id)
  JOIN ritc.shop s ON s.household_id=c.household_id AND s.shop_id=NEW.shop_id AND s.shopper_id=c.member_id
  WHERE c.household_id=NEW.household_id AND c.consent_id=NEW.consent_id AND c.member_id=NEW.member_id
  AND c.notice_version=NEW.consent_version AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND m.kind='adult' AND m.state='active'
  AND s.phase='closed' AND s.placed_revision IS NOT NULL AND s.measurement_closed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND NEW.eligible_week=to_char(s.measurement_closed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','IYYY-"W"IW')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current consent and eligible shared pickup required' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.privacy_claim(worker_lease uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(job_id uuid, issuer text, subject text, app_erased boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN QUERY WITH candidate AS(SELECT j.job_id FROM ritc.privacy_job j WHERE j.state<>'complete' AND j.next_at<=clock_timestamp() AND (j.lease_until IS NULL OR j.lease_until<clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY j.created_at,j.job_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1)
 UPDATE ritc.privacy_job j SET state='processing',lease_id=worker_lease,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',attempts=attempts+1 FROM candidate c WHERE j.job_id=c.job_id RETURNING j.job_id,j.issuer,j.subject,j.app_erased_at IS NOT NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.privacy_erase_family_decisions(target_household uuid, target_member uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 DELETE FROM ritc.family_decision WHERE household_id=target_household AND author_id=target_member;
 DELETE FROM ritc.decision_receipt WHERE household_id=target_household AND actor_id=target_member;
 -- Invalidate even superseded snapshots held by other actors. A retry may never restore erased evidence.
 UPDATE ritc.decision_receipt SET response=NULL,snapshot_observer=NULL,snapshot_promoter=NULL
 WHERE household_id=target_household AND (snapshot_observer=target_member OR snapshot_promoter=target_member);
 UPDATE ritc.family_decision SET version=version+1,
   outcome=CASE WHEN observer_id=target_member THEN NULL ELSE outcome END,
   observed_at=CASE WHEN observer_id=target_member THEN NULL ELSE observed_at END,
   observer_id=CASE WHEN observer_id=target_member THEN NULL ELSE observer_id END,
   promoted_at=CASE WHEN promoter_id=target_member THEN NULL ELSE promoted_at END,
   promoter_id=CASE WHEN promoter_id=target_member THEN NULL ELSE promoter_id END
 WHERE household_id=target_household AND (observer_id=target_member OR promoter_id=target_member);
 PERFORM ritc.privacy_erase_meal_moves(target_household,target_member);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.privacy_erase_meal_moves(target_household uuid, target_member uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 DELETE FROM ritc.meal_move WHERE household_id=target_household AND actor_id=target_member;
 UPDATE ritc.meal_planner SET planner_id=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE household_id=target_household AND planner_id=target_member;
 PERFORM ritc.privacy_erase_shared_meals(target_household,target_member);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.privacy_erase_shared_ideas(target_household uuid, target_member uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 DELETE FROM ritc.shared_meal_idea WHERE household_id=target_household AND actor_id=target_member;
 PERFORM ritc.privacy_erase_shared_changes(target_household,target_member);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.privacy_erase_shared_meals(target_household uuid, target_member uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM ritc.privacy_erase_history(target_household,target_member);
 -- Later edits can carry the original author's labels. Erase all copies of that occurrence.
 DELETE FROM ritc.shared_meal_revision m WHERE m.household_id=target_household
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ritc.shared_meal_revision a WHERE a.household_id=m.household_id
 AND a.shop_id=m.shop_id AND a.occurrence_id=m.occurrence_id AND a.actor_id=target_member);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.privacy_erasure_authorized()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT pg_has_role(session_user,'ritc_worker','MEMBER') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ritc.privacy_job WHERE job_id::text=current_setting('app.erasure_job',true) AND lease_id::text=current_setting('app.erasure_lease',true) AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND state='processing')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.privacy_preview(identity_issuer text, identity_subject text, provider_session uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF NOT ritc.provider_session_live(provider_session,identity_subject::uuid) OR ritc.identity_blocked(identity_issuer,identity_subject) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'session_needed'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('adult',NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ritc.member WHERE issuer=identity_issuer AND subject=identity_subject AND kind='child'),
 'households',COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('householdId',m.household_id,'memberId',m.member_id,'label',h.label,'state',m.state,'organizer',m.organizer,
 'otherAdults',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('memberId',a.member_id,'alias',a.alias,'organizer',a.organizer) ORDER BY a.member_id),'[]') FROM ritc.member a WHERE m.organizer AND m.state='active' AND a.household_id=m.household_id AND a.member_id<>m.member_id AND a.kind='adult' AND a.state='active'),
 'activeShops',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shopId',s.shop_id,'revision',s.revision,'authorityEpoch',s.authority_epoch,'phase',s.phase) ORDER BY s.shop_id),'[]') FROM ritc.shop s WHERE s.household_id=m.household_id AND s.shopper_id=m.member_id AND s.phase<>'closed'),
 'soleGuardianChildren',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('memberId',c.member_id,'alias',c.alias) ORDER BY c.member_id),'[]') FROM ritc.member c WHERE c.household_id=m.household_id AND c.kind='child' AND c.state='active'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ritc.guardian_relationship g JOIN ritc.consent n USING(household_id,child_id,guardian_id) WHERE g.household_id=c.household_id AND g.child_id=c.member_id AND g.guardian_id=m.member_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND n.revoked_at IS NULL)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ritc.guardian_relationship g JOIN ritc.consent n USING(household_id,child_id,guardian_id) JOIN ritc.member a ON a.household_id=g.household_id AND a.member_id=g.guardian_id WHERE g.household_id=c.household_id AND g.child_id=c.member_id AND g.guardian_id<>m.member_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND n.revoked_at IS NULL AND a.state='active'))
 ) ORDER BY m.household_id),'[]')) INTO result FROM ritc.member m JOIN ritc.household h USING(household_id) WHERE m.issuer=identity_issuer AND m.subject=identity_subject AND m.erased_at IS NULL;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ritc.provider_session_live(session_id uuid, subject_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- SHARE prevents provider deletion until this authorized transaction completes.
  PERFORM 1 FROM auth.sessions s WHERE s.id=session_id AND s.user_id=subject_id
    AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after>clock_timestamp()) FOR SHARE;
  RETURN FOUND;
END $function$
